cues.text: I heard that you're settled down
cues.translation: 네가 정착했다는 말을 들었어

cues.text: That you found a girl and you're married now
cues.translation: 넌 한 여자를 만나 이제 결혼했대

cues.text: I heard that your dreams came true
cues.translation: 네 꿈이 이루어졌단 말도 들었어

cues.text: Guess she gave you things I didn't give to you
cues.translation: 아마 그 애가 내가 주지 못한 걸 줬겠지

cues.text: Old friend, why are you so shy?
cues.translation: 오랜 친구야 왜 그렇게 수줍어해

cues.text: Ain't like you to hold back or hide from the light
cues.translation: 넌 원래 빛을 피하거나 숨는 사람 아니잖아

cues.text: I hate to turn up out of the blue, uninvited
cues.translation: 갑자기 초대도 없이 나타나긴 싫지만

cues.text: But I couldn't stay away, I couldn't fight it
cues.translation: 멀리 있을 수 없었어 막을 수도 없었어

cues.text: I had hoped you'd see my face and that you'd be reminded
cues.translation: 네가 내 얼굴을 보고 떠올리길 바랐어

cues.text: That, for me, it isn't over
cues.translation: 내게는 아직 끝나지 않았단 걸

cues.text: Never mind, I'll find someone like you
cues.translation: 됐어 너 같은 사람을 찾을게

cues.text: I wish nothing but the best for you, too
cues.translation: 너에게도 그저 좋은 일만 있길 바라

cues.text: Don't forget me, I beg, I remember you said
cues.translation: 날 잊지 마 제발 네가 말했잖아 기억해

cues.text: Sometimes it lasts in love, but sometimes it hurts instead
cues.translation: 사랑은 가끔 오래가지만 가끔은 아프기도 해

cues.text: Only yesterday was the time of our lives
cues.translation: 바로 어제만 해도 우리 인생의 시간이었는데

cues.text: We were born and raised in a summer haze
cues.translation: 여름 아지랑이 속에 태어나 자랐지

cues.text: Bound by the surprise of our glory days
